synopsis: The widespread belief in "tiny Napoleon" is a myth, largely fueled by British propaganda during his era.
narration: Forget the myth of "Tiny Napoleon." French measurements showed him to be average height for his era, around 5'6". The image of a diminutive emperor was largely crafted by British propaganda, a strategic smear campaign.

shots.prompt: Napoleon Bonaparte, in his iconic green uniform and bicorne hat, standing confidently at the center of his Imperial Guard. He appears commanding, his height proportionate to the average-sized soldiers around him, amidst a grand, formal setting.

Napoleon Bonaparte, standing on a battlefield during a strategic meeting, engaged in conversation with several of his marshals and aides. All individuals, including Napoleon, appear to be of similar, average height, demonstrating the contemporary norm without exaggeration.

music: A grand, authoritative, yet slightly mischievous classical-inspired underscore. Percussive and driving, it builds with a sense of historical gravitas, then subtly shifts to a more questioning or revealing tone, ending with a clever, abrupt flourish.
